en.bdb: Caster oil plant, oleander - cheat person -

verses.gurmukhi: ਰੁਖਾਂ ਵਿਚਿ ਕੁਰੁਖ ਹਨਿ ਦੋਵੈਂ ਅਰੰਡ ਕਨੇਰ ਦੁਆਲੇ।
verses.translit_en: rukhaa(n) vich kurukh han dhovai(n) ara(n)dd kaner dhuaale|

en.bdb: Worse among the trees, castor and oleander plants appear all around.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਰੰਡ ਫਲੈ ਅਰਡੋਲੀਆਂ ਫਲ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਬੀਅ ਚਿਤਮਿਤਾਲੇ।
verses.translit_en: ara(n)dd falai araddoleeaa(n) fal a(n)dhar beea chitamitaale|

en.bdb: Flowers grow on castor and piebald seeds remain in them.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਿਬਹੈ ਨਾਹੀਂ ਨਿਜੜਾ ਹਰਵਰਿ ਆਈ ਹੋਇ ਉਚਾਲੇ।
verses.translit_en: nibahai naahee(n) nijaRaa haravar aaiee hoi uchaale|

en.bdb: It has no deep roots and fast winds uproot it.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਲੀਆਂ ਪਵਨਿ ਕਨੇਰ ਨੋਂ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਦੁਰਗੰਧਿ ਦਿਖਾਲੇ।
verses.translit_en: kaleeaa(n) pavan kaner no(n) dhuramat vich dhuraga(n)dh dhikhaale|

en.bdb: On oleander plants grow buds which like evil sense scatter foul smell all around.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਾਹਰੁ ਲਾਲੁ ਗੁਲਾਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਅੰਦਰ ਚਿਟਾ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਨਾਲੇ।
verses.translit_en: baahar laal gulaal hoi a(n)dhar chiTaa dhubidhaa naale|

en.bdb: Outwardly they are like red rose but internally like a dilemmatic person they are white (because of the fear of many kinds).

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਗਣਤੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਭਵੈ ਭਰਨਾਲੇ।
verses.translit_en: saadhasa(n)gat gur sabadh sun ganatee vich bhavai bharanaale|

en.bdb: Even after listening to the word of the Guru in holy congregation if some body is still lost in the calculations, he goes astray in the world.
Ashes are thrown on the face of fake lover and his countenance is blackened.
